title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Asset Rates for Veterans Pension Recipients on Reduced Withholding
content:
The recorded net worth of a debtor with a running **Veterans Pension** award sets an asset rate on the approved monthly reduced withholding on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**.

| Running Veterans Pension award | Recorded net worth | Asset rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Below 25000.00 USD (low-asset limit) | 90 percent (low-asset rate) |
| Yes | At least 25000.00 USD but below 75000.00 USD (mid-asset limit) | 95 percent (mid-asset rate) |
| Yes | 75000.00 USD or more | None under this table |
| No | Any | None under this table |

The net worth is the figure recorded on the debtor's Veterans Pension award. The asset rate is a percentage by which the approved figure is multiplied before the withholding is rounded up to the cent; it acts on that figure itself.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** Net worth 24,999.99 USD: 90 percent. Exactly 25,000.00 USD: 95 percent. 74,999.99 USD: 95 percent. Exactly 75,000.00 USD: none.
